ONE-LINE BUG FIX ON BRANCH codex/run-38005965478-1 (PR #796; expected head 1403a04 — fail closed and write nothing if it moved). Only tests/conftest.py and tests/test_ci_failure_annotations.py may change.

BUG: in CI the pytest terminal reporter runs with -q and prints progress dots WITHOUT a newline. Our pytest_runtest_logreport hook is tryfirst and prints the '::error ...' annotation right after those dots, so the line is '........::error file=...' and GitHub ignores it (workflow commands must start at column 0). Reproduced locally: with two passing tests before a failing one, stdout shows '..::error file=tests/...'. Verified on PR #797: the failing unit-test job produced no annotation.

FIX: in the hook, print the annotation preceded by a newline so it always starts at column 0: print('\n' + github_failure_annotation(...), flush=True). Likewise the one-time '::warning title=pytest annotations::...' message must be printed as '\n::warning ...'. Do not change github_failure_annotation itself.

TESTS: update the existing hook test(s) in tests/test_ci_failure_annotations.py that assert on capsys output so they assert the captured text, after stripping a single leading newline, is exactly one line starting with '::error file=' — and add an assertion that the captured output starts with '\n' (so the column-0 guarantee is pinned). Keep the no-op test unchanged.

VALIDATION (paste commands and counts): 1. python -m pytest tests/test_ci_failure_annotations.py -q -p no:cacheprovider  2. probe: create tests/test_zz_probe_tmp.py with two passing tests followed by `def test_boom():\n    assert 1 == 2`, run `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_zz_probe_tmp.py -q`, confirm the output contains a line that STARTS with '::error file=tests/test_zz_probe_tmp.py' (grep '^::error'), then DELETE tests/test_zz_probe_tmp.py and confirm `git status --porcelain` does not list it  3. ruff check tests/conftest.py tests/test_ci_failure_annotations.py  4. git diff --name-only 1403a04 lists only the two allowed files. Commit message: 'ci: start pytest annotations at column 0 so GitHub parses them'.
